product_one_liner.value: CyberCube provides cyber-risk modeling and analytics that help insurers, reinsurers and brokers quantify financial cyber exposure, underwrite risks and manage portfolios.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing or plans link was found in the site navigation/footer, and /pricing returned no page; the site directs buyers to sales.

founded_year.notes: The platform was established within Symantec in 2015; CyberCube has operated as a standalone company since 2018.

eng_blog.notes: Engineer-authored posts describe the serverless-to-Kubernetes architecture migration (2022-11-02) and migration of Lambda functions to ECS (2022-02-21).

public_docs.notes: The public Help page directs users to resources inside their secured account; no public multi-article product documentation or developer reference was found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The eight listed openings include Senior Data Engineer and cyber threat/security roles, but no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The subprocessor list identifies Anthropic PBC as the LLM provider enabling the XM AI Assistant in Exposure Manager; no specific model/version is named.

last_funding.notes: Announced 2025-10-01, led by Spectrum Equity, subject to customary regulatory approvals. The release states more than $180 million; the numeric amount is the disclosed threshold, not an exact total. No numbered Series designation was announced.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No SDR, BDR or account-executive title appears among the eight openings; Senior Director, (Re)Insurance Sales is excluded under the requested title rules.

launched_6mo.notes: On 2026-10-13, CyberCube announced that Broking Manager now adds an APAC regional view of loss-severity, incident-frequency and security-posture benchmarks, a substantive regional analytics capability.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On 2026-02-09, Pascal Millaire stepped down as CEO and became Senior Advisor; Chris Methven succeeded him through an internal promotion rather than an external hire.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The DPA names HubSpot as CRM. A closed SDR posting also names HubSpot, ZoomInfo and LinkedIn Sales Navigator; that posting is evidence of system usage, not current hiring.
